series.name: 苏东坡 · 一生行迹
series.description:
按苏轼一生为官、贬谪的路线排序，一站一首诗，一首诗一集，每集朗读完整的一首诗。每集四步：
① 出片头图：H3-Image 画一张古地图片头（标题、当前地点、年号与公元年份写在图上，朱砂线连起走过的地方）；
② 逐镜出视频：第 1 镜用片头图作首帧，0–3 秒停在地图上再切实景；之后每镜朗读一两句，「接上一镜」的镜头用上一镜最后一帧作首帧，「新场景」的镜头直接文生视频；古琴与箫的配乐贯穿全系列；
③ 承上启下：每集末尾一段地图动画，朱砂线走向下一站，旁白交代这一站之后的经历，画面写「下一集 · 《诗名》· 地点 · 时间」；最后一集为结语；
④ 合成成片：按顺序拼接所有镜头，画面上方叠加《诗名》与作者 · 地点 · 时间，下方逐句字幕，全诗片尾 7 秒，再接承上启下，输出 1080P 和 SRT 字幕。
series.style: clean live-action footage from edge to edge in a cinematic Northern Song historical film look: restrained ink-wash palette of misty blue-grey, pale jade and warm amber, natural light only, gentle film grain, historically accurate clothing and architecture.

groups.name: ① 初入仕途（1056–1069）
groups.note: 1056 随父苏洵、弟苏辙出蜀进京；1057 进士及第；1061 制科入三等，签书凤翔府判官（1061–1064）；1065 还朝，妻王弗病逝；1066 父丧回蜀守制，1069 还朝。

groups.name: ② 熙宁外放（1071–1079）
groups.note: 因反对新法自请外放：1071–1074 杭州通判；1074–1076 密州知州；1077–1079 徐州知州（抗洪）；1079 调湖州知州，到任三个月被捕。

groups.name: ③ 乌台诗案 · 黄州（1079–1084）
groups.note: 1079 乌台诗案，下御史台狱一百三十余日；1080–1084 贬黄州团练副使，躬耕东坡，自号东坡居士；1084 量移汝州，途经庐山。

groups.name: ④ 元祐起落（1085–1093）
groups.note: 1085 起知登州，到任五日召还，任翰林学士；1089–1091 杭州知州，疏浚西湖、筑苏堤；1091 颍州、1092 扬州、1093 定州。

groups.name: ⑤ 绍圣南迁 · 北归（1094–1101）
groups.note: 1094 贬惠州；1097 再贬儋州（海南）；1100 遇赦北归，渡琼州海峡；1101 途经镇江金山寺，七月卒于常州。

episodes.title: 01 · 飞鸿雪泥 · 和子由渑池怀旧
episodes.author: 苏轼
episodes.date: 嘉祐六年 · 1061 · 赴凤翔签判途中
episodes.post: 签书凤翔府判官（赴任途中）
episodes.poem:
人生到处知何似，应似飞鸿踏雪泥。
泥上偶然留指爪，鸿飞那复计东西。
老僧已死成新塔，坏壁无由见旧题。
往日崎岖还记否，路长人困蹇驴嘶。
episodes.note: 顺序：① 出片头图（核对图上的字）→ ② 从第 1 镜起逐镜出视频（接上一镜的镜头会自动用上一镜最后一帧做首帧；不满意可「再出一条」，在成片列表里点「留用」指定用哪条）→ ③ 出承上启下（地图动画 + 旁白，交代之后的经历并预告下一集，不依赖前面的镜头，随时可出）→ ④ 合成成片：自动拼接、加诗名/时间地点/逐句字幕、片尾整首诗，最后接承上启下。

Mountains are drawn as blue-green brush strokes, the Yellow River and the Yangtze as fine flowing ink lines, the sea to the east and south as pale wave patterns, with a faint brocade mounting border around the map. Small ink dots mark the places he lived, and a thin vermilion ink line links them in order: Meishan in the Sichuan basin in the far west, then the capital Kaifeng on the Yellow River in the north centre, then Mianchi, west of the capital on the road to Fengxiang. At the top centre, a title in elegant black regular-script calligraphy reads "苏东坡 · 一生行迹". Next to the glowing dot, a small label in black calligraphy reads "渑池". At the bottom centre, a line in black regular-script calligraphy reads "嘉祐六年 · 1061 · 赴凤翔签判途中".

sections.summary: The map title card holds still for three seconds, then the film cuts to a young Su Shi standing on a snowy road as a wild goose flies off and leaves its footprints in the snow.
sections.retention_analysis: [Shot 1] keeps the map card exactly as in <Picture 1>: locked off, no camera movement, every calligraphy label stays crisp and unchanged, only the vermilion dot glows softly. [Shot 2] is clean live-action footage from edge to edge in a cinematic Northern Song historical film look: restrained ink-wash palette of misty blue-grey, pale jade and warm amber, natural light only, gentle film grain, historically accurate clothing and architecture. identity_preserved - keep his face, beard, hat and costume through the shot. Natural real-time speed, no slow motion. No people other than those described appear. No subtitles, captions or new writing appear anywhere in Shot 2.
sections.detailed_description: [Shot 1] (0–3 s) The antique map title card from <Picture 1>, locked off and perfectly still; the vermilion dot at Mianchi pulses softly once. [Shot 2] (3–12 s) A snowy mountain road beside the crumbling wall of an old temple at dusk. Su Shi, a slender Northern Song scholar-official in his mid-twenties with a long oval face, bright eyes and a short neat black beard, wearing a plain dark grey travelling cloak over a pale robe and a black futou hat. The camera slowly pushes in from a wide shot to a medium shot of him and stops there. 3-6 s: Su Shi stands beside his grey donkey on the snowy road, holding its rein loosely, and looks down at a row of small bird footprints pressed into the snow. 6-9 s: a wild goose lifts off from the snow ahead of him with two strong wing beats and flies away into the pale sky, leaving only its footprints; his gaze follows it upward. 9-12 s: he exhales a slow breath of mist and gives a faint, rueful smile, snowflakes settling on his cloak. From about 4 s, an off-screen mature male narrator recites in Mandarin Chinese, in voice-over, slow, warm and resonant, with a natural breath between the lines: “人生到处知何四，应四飞鸿踏雪泥。” Su Shi himself never speaks: his lips stay closed and he never looks into the camera lens. One continuous shot after the cut, no further cuts.
sections.overall_soundscape: soft wind over snow, the donkey snorting once, the goose's wing beats, distant temple wind chimes. The only voice is the off-screen narrator reciting the quoted lines; no other speech.
sections.non_diegetic_music: a slow, gentle solo guqin melody with a soft xiao bamboo flute, the same quiet theme in every episode, starting softly at 0 s under the map and kept low beneath the recitation.

episodes.author: 苏轼
episodes.date: 熙宁八年 · 1075 · 密州知州
episodes.poem:
十年生死两茫茫，不思量，自难忘。千里孤坟，无处话凄凉。纵使相逢应不识，尘满面，鬓如霜。
夜来幽梦忽还乡，小轩窗，正梳妆。相顾无言，惟有泪千行。料得年年肠断处，明月夜，短松冈。

episodes.date: 熙宁九年 · 1076 · 密州 · 中秋
episodes.poem:
明月几时有？把酒问青天。不知天上宫阙，今夕是何年。我欲乘风归去，又恐琼楼玉宇，高处不胜寒。起舞弄清影，何似在人间。
转朱阁，低绮户，照无眠。不应有恨，何事长向别时圆？人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全。但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。

episodes.author: 苏轼
episodes.date: 元丰元年 · 1078 · 徐州知州
episodes.poem:
簌簌衣巾落枣花，村南村北响缫车，牛衣古柳卖黄瓜。
酒困路长惟欲睡，日高人渴漫思茶，敲门试问野人家。

episodes.poem:
大江东去，浪淘尽，千古风流人物。故垒西边，人道是，三国周郎赤壁。乱石穿空，惊涛拍岸，卷起千堆雪。江山如画，一时多少豪杰。

episodes.title: 06 · 五色蝶泉 · 滇游日记
episodes.author: 徐霞客
episodes.date: 崇祯十二年 · 1639 · 三月
episodes.poem:
泉上大树，当四月初，即发花如蛱蝶，须翅栩然，与生蝶无异；
又有真蝶千万，连须钩足，自树巅倒悬而下，及于泉面，
缤纷络绎，五色焕然。
